name: 11/01 SS Legion 1
rem:
• Rally leaders: use the 2K gem buffs if possible (attack, lethality, defence, health, deployment).
• Keep at least 2 players on buildings 1, 2 and 4.
• If 3 or 7 is hit, focus on recapturing. Never trade a core building for kills.
• Reinforce immediately when called. Join your assigned pair — don't wander.
• Garrison leaders: do not abandon buildings, appoint a strong garrison captain before leaving.
Joiners
• Keep scanning the entire map: when a building flips sides, grab the scattered loot before the enemy does.
• Send any unused weak march to gather at the Undercellars when they open.
• Don't leave troops at home. Keep all marches busy.

groups.note:
1. Teleport and launch a solo attack.
2. Start a rally if needed.
3. Defenders stay behind and hold positions. Do NOT move.
4. Joiners must join every rally, collect loot, and gather at under cellars (when they open).

- IMPORTANT: If your TC is below 30, do NOT teleport near the enemy. Stay in the safe zone and speed up your march to join rallies.
- Keep all marches busy
- If being attacked: teleport before attack lands, send all troops to camp outside
